text: {"lessons":["I tend to sell positions once they show a gain, but repeated profit-taking can leave me with less exposure to stocks that may keep rising; I should weigh each sale against the portfolio plan.","Selling winners felt satisfying, yet my account value fell in the last two periods, so locking in gains alone does not protect the whole portfolio from losses elsewhere.","I should judge each holding by its future risk and return, not just whether it is above or below my purchase cost, and keep diversification in mind."]}
